Judge to decide trial for man accused in Charlie Kirk assassination attempt

A judge is set to decide whether Tyler Robinson will stand trial in connection with an alleged assassination attempt on Charlie Kirk. Prosecutors reportedly brought up the assassination attempt of a Trump butler in the Tyler Robinson case during a hearing. The specific details of the judge's decision and the trial date have not yet been announced.
